text:
devon: URGENT handoff — SolaHealth trial hitting onboarding blockers, CS flagged as renewal-risk. Customer runs large embed ingest tonight for demo tomorrow; ingestion jobs keep returning 502s for embeddings endpoint. Need quick triage + customer comm plan.

maya: Thanks for the heads up. Quick Qs: do we know if this is auth / quota / model OOM? Can someone paste the last error log? I want to align CS messaging. :spiral_calendar:

lin: short debug: saw repeated 502s from /v1/embeddings with 'upstream read timeout' in nginx logs. Example: `2024-03-30T01:12:05Z ERROR upstream read timeout for host model-runner-3` Also relevant: redis prefix-cache miss spike at 01:10. Not seeing 401/403.

lin: immediate mitigation options: 1) flip the customer's route to fallback model `m-small-1` (lower mem, slightly higher latency) 2) enable temporary burst on their Dedicated capacity (if tenant is eligible) 3) ask support to throttle batch size to 16 per request. Command to flip route (ops): `redwood route update --tenant solahealth --model m-small-1 --reason "temp fallback for embed ingest"`

devon: Can ops run that route flip now? If not, we'll tell CS to ask Sola to throttle ingest to 6 concurrent workers and reduce batch_size to 8 until we're stable.

arjun: Draft for CS outreach (send within 10m): "Hi team — quick note from Redwood: we're investigating an ingestion error affecting embeddings. Can you temporarily reduce concurrent workers to 6 and batch_size to 8? We're enabling a safe fallback on our end and will confirm when full ingest is OK. Apologies for disruption; will follow up in 30m with status." Thoughts?

maya: That works. Add explicit ETA: we'll confirm within 30m and target full resolution in 2 hours. Also record escalation to renewal-risk tracker: "SolaHealth trial — demo scheduled tomorrow — ingestion errors — mitigation in progress."

devon: Ops: please confirm when fallback is live. Lin: can you monitor KV cache hit-rate and pod restarts for next 60m? I'll own CS comms and sync with AE.

lin: Starting monitor now. Subscribed to logs and will post a 5m pulse. If fallback fails, next step is to scale model-runner pool + restart pods: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-runner --namespace inference-prod`

oncall-bot: Incident INC-20240330-47 created by lin — priority=P1 — SolaHealth ingestion 502s. Pager duty notified. https://redwood.incidents/INC-20240330-47

devon: OK sending initial note to Sola and staging CS thread. Action items: (1) ops route flip or scale (owner: lin) (2) ask customer to throttle (owner: maya) (3) AE heads-up + renewal note (owner: arjun) (4) post mortem placeholder (owner: devon). Will update thread in 10m. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks all — I'll ping legal/compliance if any data retention concerns crop up. Keep me posted on whether we need a more formal exec comms.

lin: Fallback route active at 1709200120. KV miss rate dropped ~40% after flip. No pod restarts required yet. Continuing to monitor.

devon: Received — I'll tell SolaHealth we've enabled fallback and to throttle per the draft. Following up in 20.

arjun: Noted, adding renewal-risk tag to the account and flagging for tomorrow's demo team.

lin: 5m pulse @1709200360: error rate down to baseline (~2 errors/min), CPU on model-runner-3 still elevated but stable. Leaving monitors for 2 hours.

maya: Great work team. Postmortem please include times, customer impact, mitigation steps, and suggested long-term fixes (model-runner autoscaling and smarter pre-warming for large batched ingests).

devon: Closing the handoff for CS — will open the PM/infra ticket for autoscale suggestions. Will also attach the comm transcript to the renewal-risk playbook.
